# Guil Hernandez

> Software developer and educator creating courses, curriculum, demos, and tools on AI agents, JavaScript, Python, and TypeScript. His courses have reached 550,000+ learners worldwide.

I'm Guil, a developer and educator working with Python, TypeScript, and agentic AI. My courses have reached 550,000+ learners worldwide, from first lines of JavaScript to production AI agents, across 150+ courses on 7+ platforms.

I've worked at [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com/), led curriculum for [Podium's first AI-native web development program](https://www.podium.fas.harvard.edu/coding-for-web), built courses for [Scrimba](https://scrimba.com/) and [LinkedIn Learning](https://www.linkedin.com/learning/instructors/guil-hernandez), and led the software curriculum and instructor team at [Treehouse](https://teamtreehouse.com/).

Open to collaborations on AI courses, developer education programs, conference talks, and curriculum consulting.
